nodes.description: Public uint256 maximum token supply limit (9999) checked in claim()
private mapping(uint256 => uint256) storing the block.timestamp seed for each minted tokenId
private mapping(address => uint256) counting claims per address, used as a one-claim guard
mapping(address => uint256) token balance per owner, mutated on mint, transfer and burn
mapping(uint256 => address) owner of each tokenId
uint256[] of all existing tokenIds; its length defines totalSupply()
uint256 reentrancy lock variable (1 = NOT_ENTERED, 2 = ENTERED)
address of the contract owner, only writable through _setOwner
public nonReentrant claim(): mints a new token to msg.sender after checking _claimed and maxLimit
public view tokenURI(uint256): builds the on-chain SVG and JSON metadata using seeded randomness
private view getSign(uint256): derives a fortune index 0-3 from keccak256 seeded by numbers[tokenId]
public view getPhaseOfMoon(uint256): pseudo-random moon phase between 1 and 15
public view getSignNamesElements(uint256): returns the four-line fortune strings
public view getSignElement(uint256): returns the fortune label for a token
internal pure random(string): keccak256 of the input, providing deterministic pseudo-randomness
internal pure toString(uint256): decimal conversion used for metadata output and seeding
internal _safeMint(address,uint256[,bytes]): mints the token then calls _checkOnERC721Received
internal _mint(address,uint256): updates _balances and _owners and emits Transfer
private function performing an external call to onERC721Received on contract recipients
ERC721Enumerable hook that updates enumeration structures before mint, transfer or burn
private helper pushing tokenId into _allTokens and recording its index
public view totalSupply(): returns _allTokens.length, used to derive the next tokenId
modifier nonReentrant: requires _status != _ENTERED and toggles the lock around the body
modifier onlyOwner: requires owner() == _msgSender()
public onlyOwner transferOwnership(address): transfers ownership to newOwner
public onlyOwner renounceOwnership(): sets the owner to address(0)
private _setOwner(address): writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
internal view _msgSender(): returns msg.sender
internal pure Base64 encoder used for the token metadata payloads
internal _transfer(address,address,uint256): moves balances and ownership and clears approvals
internal _burn(uint256): clears approvals, decrements balance and deletes the owner
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller address used as claim key and mint recipient
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time value stored in numbers[tokenId] during claim()
External call IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(...) transferring control to an arbitrary contract
Write of block.timestamp into numbers[tokenId], making token metadata dependent on miner timestamp
Balance and supply arithmetic (_balances += 1 / -= 1) performed in _mint, _transfer and _burn
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue forwarding all available gas
tokenId parameter of MoonDraw.tokenURI
tokenId parameter of MoonDraw.getSign
input string parameter of MoonDraw.random used as the keccak256 seed
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership
payable recipient address of Address.sendValue
amount of wei forwarded by Address.sendValue
local tokenId = totalSupply() + 1 computed inside claim()
local rand pseudo-random value inside getSign() driving the branch selection

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller keyed in _claimed and the address receiving the minted token in claim()
claim() increments _claimed[msg.sender] to mark the address as having already claimed
claim() requires _claimed[msg.sender] == 0 before allowing a mint
claim() writes numbers[tokenId] for the newly minted token
block.timestamp becomes the per-token seed value stored by claim()
timestamp write mutates the numbers mapping that every metadata getter reads
claim() executes the miner-influenceable timestamp write
nonReentrant modifier wraps the claim() body with the _status lock
nonReentrant reads and writes the _status lock variable
claim() calls totalSupply() to derive the next tokenId
totalSupply() returns the length of _allTokens
local tokenId is assigned totalSupply() + 1 inside claim()
the computed tokenId is passed as the mint argument to _safeMint
claim() calls _safeMint which can transfer control to an arbitrary receiver contract
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token
_mint increments _balances[to]
_mint sets _owners[tokenId] = to
_mint performs balance arithmetic on the supply state
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before writing state
the enumeration hook adds newly minted tokens to the all-tokens data structure
_addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration pushes tokenId into _allTokens
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after the mint completes
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call into IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received
receiver code executes while claim() is in flight; re-entering claim() is blocked by nonReentrant
_msgSender() simply returns msg.sender into the calling context
_checkOnERC721Received passes _msgSender() as the operator argument of the receiver callback
recipient is the target of the low-level call inside Address.sendValue
amount is forwarded as the call value inside Address.sendValue
the input string seeds keccak256 inside random()
tokenId selects numbers[tokenId] inside getSign()
getSign reads numbers[tokenId] as its randomness seed
getSign calls random() on a tokenId and number derived string
getPhaseOfMoon calls random() on a derived string
getPhaseOfMoon reads numbers[tokenId]
getSignNamesElements calls getSign to select the fortune table
getSignElement calls getSign to select the fortune label
tokenId selects which token is rendered by tokenURI
tokenURI calls getPhaseOfMoon for the moon element
tokenURI calls getSignElement for the fortune label
tokenURI calls getSignNamesElements for the fortune text
tokenURI calls toString for the token id and attribute values
tokenURI base64-encodes the SVG and the JSON metadata
tokenURI indirectly reads numbers[tokenId] through the seed-based getters
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership to the current owner
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the current owner
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender()
transferOwnership calls _setOwner(newOwner)
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0))
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner address
the newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance
_transfer writes _owners[tokenId] = to
_burn decrements _balances[owner]
local rand value in getSign drives the sign selection branches

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter only feeds the tokenURI rendering routine, so it normalizes into that core function.
getSign's tokenId parameter is used only to index numbers[tokenId] inside getSign.
The input string is merely the seed argument of the internal random() helper.
newOwner is the sole argument of the owner-only transferOwnership function.
recipient is the target address of the low-level value call performed by Address.sendValue.
amount is the value forwarded by the low-level call performed by Address.sendValue.
The local tokenId exists only inside claim() and is passed straight into _safeMint.
The local rand value exists only inside getSign() to select the fortune index.
